commitments.detail: All family members will be invited to review and provide corrections before publication.
Living family members' personal information will only be visible to other living family members.
All living individuals mentioned in the update will have their visibility limited to prevent identification.
All living individuals mentioned will have their visibility limited to protect privacy.

All records must cite their source to maintain accuracy and credibility.
